S.FORM: 惡靈戰警e-ling-can-cin e-lin-can-cin (nu Amilika: Ghost Rider), duma a nibelih sa yu-lin-ci-se, yu-lin-ce-sen, duma sa yu-lin-can-ce) sa, nuyda u manuy manhua a nipisanga' a pacebaay caw-ce-lan huwan-ing-siung. 2011 mihcan limaay a bulad, e-ling-can-cin itida i IGN a cacay a lasebu kaicelang a manga a cudad, nu ing-siung mintan u silac sa siwa a bataan. nu aydaay a cudad nu mangga mutahkalay a e-ling-can-cin situngusay a tamdaw sa sasepat. 人物tademaw u wayway nu e-ling-can-cin sa mayda u matuduhay ku udip nu tamdaw, sidakuc tu nubangesay atu mumukunay tu budiki, pasu mikacaw i matuduhay a utubay tacuwacuwa misuayaw tu ada. u nikaydan nu utubay mawaswas aca, i dadan sini, adayaca tu nikadan nu lamal. u sayaway a e-ling-can-cin anikatahkal amududuc makatukuh i no-ya-bang-cu nadikudad, pakayda nipatukil nu kamisama acay tu katahkal ku hatiniyay katabaki a labades mibakin tu tamdaw, sisa cinida tahkal ku nisanga'an tu (hu-co-ce-ling) pabeli i tamdaw, u hu-co-ce-ling cinida ku mikilimay dadapuwan, pasu a pabeli tu saka e-ling-can-cin a icelang a mibakin tu cumi, uyda u i cuwacuwaay a e-ling-can-cin a icelang atu wayway a adidiw ku caay kalecad, mayda nu Intu a e-ling-can-cin amahida u hu-co-ni-sen ku wayway, nu Dipun a e-ling-can-cin kapah sinidikec tu nu bu-tung-min-wang a icelang, nu Ingko a e-ling-can-cin sa, uyda u tang-huwang-tuy ciye-ke a wayway nu tahkal. . nuyda u hu-co-ce-ling a katatahkalan nuyda nu kamisama a nisanga'an adada, duma sa idaw ku maydaay u yense hucocelin, anu emocelin aicelang anisangan a hucocelin, nu idaway ku elincancin a icelang a kakawsan a hucocelin, mapatayay nu laluman a adingu a hucocelin namin, mahiniyay a laed idawaca ku adidiway caay kalcad. nika anu haminhan patahkal ku icelang , aidawnamin ku alcaday tunu kamisama anisangan a hucocelin a siyang tong tenci. 強尼·布雷茲cangni.puleyc mangga nu sayaway a elincancin utatelungan sa nu utubay teci' cysi cangnin.puleyc sayaway mutahkal i Marvel Spotlight#5 musakakawaw tu sakapatayaw a utubay teci atamdaw; ilabi Ci nida masumad mala (elin cancin) miedap Ci meyfeyste, nika u cise audip, cacayay alasebu kabaeket mangalepaca, anu idawtu kubaluhayay akawaw mutahkal ni meyfeyste, u cinida amusumad tuway tuudip, laecus musakakawaw tu hicahica. mamin ku kawaw, sibalucu Cinida midademec tu minin, pakilil tu ineng nu udip miedap tu kadihiyan imelangay a
